content: dupeGuru: three matching modes (Content/MD5 byte-exact = zero false positives, Filename fuzzy match, Folder mode). Adjustable match-threshold slider (fuzziness) trades recall for false-positive risk. Safety defaults: one file per duplicate group is always marked as the reference and cannot be selected for deletion; deletions default to Recycle Bin not permanent delete; users mark which duplicates to act on before Send to Recycle Bin.
